column1: A still, empty room with a patterned carpet. A tall padded armchair stands behind a round, cloth-covered table, and a small chair with a lyre-shaped back faces it. No one sits in either.
column2: 一间安静空荡的房间，铺着花纹地毯。圆桌上盖着桌布，后面是一把高背软垫扶手椅，对面是一把椅背呈竖琴形的小椅子。两把椅子上都没有人。

column1: Your room in the dorm. You stand by the small sink, hands in your pockets, then turn, flip open your phone and check it.
column2: 你在宿舍的房间里。你双手插在口袋里站在小水槽边，然后转身，翻开手机查看。

column1: The school gate. Bag over your shoulder, hands in your pockets, you walk in, and a friend comes over to join you.
column2: 学校校门。你背着包，双手插在口袋里走进去，一位朋友走过来与你同行。

column1: The two of you walk on into school together.
column2: 你们两人一起走进学校。

column1: At the school gate, Junpei hurries over to you.
column2: 在学校校门口，顺平匆匆朝你跑来。

column1: Your classroom. You set your bag on your desk and sit down. Two classmates stand chatting in the aisle beside you.
column2: 你的教室。你把包放在桌上坐下。两个同学站在你旁边的过道里聊天。

column1: By the shoe lockers at school. Bag over your shoulder, hands in your pockets, you stop near two girls whispering together by the lockers, one with a hand raised to her mouth.
column2: 学校的鞋柜旁。你背着包，双手插在口袋里，在两个女生附近停下，她们在鞋柜边窃窃私语，其中一人抬手掩着嘴。

column1: At the school gate, Yukari catches up with you and walks beside you.
column2: 在学校校门口，由加莉追上你，与你并肩而行。

column1: Ryoji walks up behind Yukari and joins you both.
column2: 绫时从由加莉身后走来，加入你们。

column1: Yukari's face falls. She turns away from Ryoji without an answer and walks off past you. Ryoji reaches a hand out after her.
column2: 由加莉脸色一沉。她没有回答，转身背对绫时，从你身边走开。绫时朝她的背影伸出一只手。

column1: In the classroom, Junpei sits at his desk with Ryoji standing beside it. You walk over to them.
column2: 教室里，顺平坐在课桌前，绫时站在桌旁。你走向他们。

column1: A lesson in your classroom. You sit at your desk among the class, Junpei and Yukari nearby, while the teacher talks at the front.
column2: 你教室里的一堂课。你坐在全班同学中间的座位上，顺平和由加莉就在附近，老师在前面讲课。

column1: A lesson in your classroom. You sit at your desk among the class, Junpei and Yukari nearby, and the teacher stands at the front by the blackboard.
column2: 你教室里的一堂课。你坐在全班同学中间的座位上，顺平和由加莉就在附近，老师站在前面的黑板旁。

column1: A lesson in your classroom. You sit at your desk, Junpei at the desk beside you and Yukari nearby, while the teacher talks at the front.
column2: 你教室里的一堂课。你坐在座位上，顺平坐在你旁边，由加莉就在附近，老师在前面讲课。

column1: Junpei, a bead of sweat on his brow, turns his head toward you.
column2: 顺平额头冒着汗珠，转头看向你。

column1: An exam in your classroom. Everyone sits bent over their papers, pencils moving, you, Junpei and Yukari among them, and the teacher watches from a chair at the front.
column2: 你教室里的一场考试。大家都埋头写着卷子，铅笔沙沙作响，你、顺平和由加莉也在其中，老师坐在前面的椅子上监考。

column1: Your classroom, silent during an exam. You and your classmates, Junpei and Yukari among them, sit bent over your papers.
column2: 考试中鸦雀无声的教室。你和同学们都埋头写着卷子，顺平和由加莉也在其中。

column1: A school hallway. Students crowd in front of the exam results posted on the wall, and you head over to them.
column2: 学校走廊。学生们挤在墙上张贴的考试成绩前，你走了过去。

column1: The nurse's office. The school nurse leans in toward you.
column2: 保健室。校医朝你俯身凑近。

column1: After a moment, you are holding a steaming cup of his brew.
column2: 片刻后，你手里捧着一杯冒着热气的药汤。

column1: You raise the steaming cup and drink it down in one go, your face screwing up.
column2: 你举起冒着热气的杯子，一口气喝下去，整张脸皱成一团。

column1: Mr. Edogawa brews something up and hands you a steaming cup.
column2: 江户川老师熬好一碗东西，递给你一杯冒着热气的药汤。

column1: You sit at the computer desk in the dorm lounge, chin in hand, then type away at the keyboard.
column2: 你坐在宿舍休息室的电脑桌前，托着下巴，然后敲起键盘。

column1: The dorm lounge. You come in to find Ikutsuki sitting on the sofas with Junpei and Yukari.
column2: 宿舍休息室。你走进去，看到几月坐在沙发上，顺平和由加莉也在。

column1: Akihiko, Fuuka and Mitsuru come over to the sofas and join the group.
column2: 明彦、风花和美鹤走到沙发旁，加入大家。

column1: A room at the hospital. You sit while Ikutsuki walks over to you.
column2: 医院里的一个房间。你坐着，几月朝你走来。

column1: Ikutsuki's phone beeps. He turns away and walks off out of sight to take the call, leaving you sitting alone at the table.
column2: 几月的手机响了一声。他转过身，走到看不见的地方接电话，留下你一个人坐在桌边。

column1: Iwatodai Station. A clock reads 11:59.
column2: 严户台站前。时钟显示11点59分。

column1: Outside Iwatodai Station, you walk out alone onto a plaza where puddles of blood mark the paving.
column2: 走出严户台站，你独自走上一片广场，铺石地面上有一滩滩血迹。

column1: You break into a run.
column2: 你拔腿跑了起来。

column1: On the Moonlight Bridge, a giant Shadow crouches beside a stopped truck, its huge mouth gaping with rows of teeth. Takaya stands facing it. You run up and stop a few steps behind him.
column2: 月光大桥上，一只巨大的暗影蹲伏在一辆停下的卡车旁，巨口大张，露出一排排牙齿。隆哉面对着它站着。你跑上前，在他身后几步远停下。

column1: You drop into a fighting stance, facing the Shadow.
column2: 你摆出战斗姿势，面对暗影。

column1: The Shadow is gone. You lower your guard and face Takaya on the bridge.
column2: 暗影消失了。你放下戒备，在桥上面对隆哉。

column1: Takaya walks past you and stops with his back to you. You walk up behind him.
column2: 隆哉从你身边走过，背对着你停下。你走到他身后。

column1: Takaya walks off along the bridge. Mitsuru rides up on a motorcycle, stops beside you and takes off her helmet.
column2: 隆哉沿着大桥走开。美鹤骑着摩托车赶来，在你身旁停下，摘下头盔。

column1: In the dorm lounge, Koromaru whines up at Aigis, his head low. You walk over to them, hands in your pockets.
column2: 宿舍休息室里，虎狼丸低着头，朝埃癸斯呜咽。你双手插在口袋里走向它们。

column1: Koromaru trots over to you. You crouch beside him, and he pants happily.
column2: 虎狼丸小跑到你身边。你蹲在它旁边，它高兴地喘着气。

column1: You walk Koromaru into Naganaki Shrine. He stops short and growls at someone ahead.
column2: 你带着虎狼丸走进长鸣神社。它猛地停下，朝前方的某人低吼。

column1: Takaya steps out toward you. You take a fighting stance, Koromaru bristling beside you.
column2: 隆哉朝你走出来。你摆出战斗姿势，虎狼丸在你身旁竖起毛发。

column1: Takaya turns his back and walks off up the shrine path. You lower your guard, and Koromaru turns and looks up at you.
column2: 隆哉转过身，沿着神社的小路走去。你放下戒备，虎狼丸转头抬眼看着你。

column1: You set off after Takaya, Koromaru following.
column2: 你追在隆哉身后出发，虎狼丸跟在后面。

column1: Naganaki Shrine, among the torii gates. You stand with Koromaru at your side, facing Takaya a few steps away.
column2: 长鸣神社，鸟居之间。虎狼丸在你身旁，你面对着几步外的隆哉站着。

column1: Takaya walks over to stand at your shoulder, leans in close and hands you a folded piece of paper.
column2: 隆哉走过来，站到你肩旁，凑近身子，递给你一张折起的纸。

column1: Takaya turns and walks away. You take out your phone and look at it.
column2: 隆哉转身走开。你拿出手机看了看。

column1: In a run-down hideout open to the city, Takaya sits on a bench with a sheet of paper in his hands, Jin standing beside him. Tartarus rises in the distance. A revolver lies on the table in front of them.
column2: 在一处朝城市敞开的破败藏身处，隆哉坐在长椅上，手里拿着一张纸，壬站在他身旁。远处耸立着塔尔塔罗斯。他们面前的桌上放着一把左轮手枪。

column1: You cross the plaza at Port Island Station and stop short: Takaya is waiting by a pillar.
column2: 你穿过辰巳港湾人工岛站前的广场，猛地停下：隆哉正等在一根柱子旁。

column1: Takaya turns and walks off. You follow him.
column2: 隆哉转身走开。你跟着他。

column1: Takaya waits by some steps in a deserted street. He turns as you walk up to him.
column2: 隆哉在一条无人街道的台阶旁等候。你走近时，他转过身来。

column1: A still image: a monstrous creature with a gaping, tooth-lined maw rears over a long-haired girl and a boy, who braces in front of it.
column2: 一幅静止的画面：一头怪物张着布满牙齿的大嘴，高高俯在一个长发女孩和一个男孩身上，男孩挡在它前面。

column1: Takaya turns his back on you and walks away, a revolver tucked in his belt. You are left standing alone.
column2: 隆哉背对着你走开，腰带里插着一把左轮手枪。你独自留在原地。

column1: Takaya stands at a railing looking out over the city, a suspension bridge and Tartarus under a huge moon. Jin walks up behind him.
column2: 隆哉站在栏杆旁眺望城市，巨大的月亮下是一座吊桥和塔尔塔罗斯。壬从他身后走来。

column1: In a crowded nightclub, a man in a suit walks up to you.
column2: 在拥挤的夜店里，一个西装男子朝你走来。

column1: The man walks off across the plaza and waits by a staircase.
column2: 那男子穿过广场走开，在一段楼梯旁等候。

column1: In a back alley, a man in a suit stands waiting. You walk up to him.
column2: 在一条后巷里，一个西装男子站着等候。你走向他。

column1: You walk past him, deeper into the alley, to where Takaya waits beside some bins.
column2: 你从他身边走过，深入巷中，走到隆哉等候的地方，旁边有几个垃圾桶。

column1: Takaya draws a revolver from his belt and turns it over in his hand as he talks, then tucks it back into his belt.
column2: 隆哉从腰带里抽出一把左轮手枪，一边说话一边在手里翻转，然后又插回腰带。

column1: Takaya walks past you and away, the revolver tucked back in his belt.
column2: 隆哉从你身边走过，渐渐远去，左轮手枪已插回腰带。

column1: Your classroom. You sit at your desk; Junpei sits turned round in the seat in front of you and Yukari sits on the next desk. The door opens and Mitsuru walks in and comes over to you.
column2: 你的教室。你坐在座位上；顺平转过身坐在你前面的座位上，由加莉坐在旁边的课桌上。门打开，美鹤走进来，来到你面前。

column1: Mitsuru turns and walks out of the classroom.
column2: 美鹤转身走出教室。

column1: Fuuka's room in the dorm. Fuuka sits at a low table, typing on a laptop. There is a knock at the door.
column2: 宿舍里风花的房间。风花坐在矮桌旁，在笔记本电脑上打字。有人敲门。

column1: Yukari opens the door, walks in and stops by the low table, looking down at Fuuka. As they talk, she clasps her hands behind her back.
column2: 由加莉打开门走进来，在矮桌旁停下，低头看着风花。交谈时，她双手背在身后交握。

column1: The dorm's command room. You sit around the table with Yukari, Junpei, Akihiko, Mitsuru, Fuuka and Ikutsuki, the chairman.
column2: 宿舍的指挥室。你和由加莉、顺平、明彦、美鹤、风花以及理事长几月围坐在桌旁。

column1: Ikutsuki gets up, steps over to a metal case on the table and opens it: inside are folded combat gear, an armband and a row of cartridges.
column2: 几月站起来，走到桌上的一只金属箱旁打开：里面是叠好的战斗服、一条臂章和一排弹匣。

column1: Ikutsuki stands and leaves through the door.
column2: 几月站起身，从门口离开。

column1: Tartarus's entrance hall. All six of you stand together in new combat gear, each outfit a little different.
column2: 塔尔塔罗斯的大厅。你们六人一起站着，都穿着新的战斗服，每件款式各有一点不同。

column1: Fuuka closes her eyes. Her Persona rises around her: a towering figure of a woman with her arms spread wide, the lower half of her a great dome that closes over Fuuka.
column2: 风花闭上眼睛。她的Persona在她身周升起：一尊高大的女性身影，双臂张开，下半身化作一座大圆顶，罩住了风花。

column1: Inside Tartarus, you stand alone in a corridor. You turn around: no one else is there.
column2: 塔尔塔罗斯里，你独自站在走廊上。你转过身：没有别人。

column1: Elsewhere on the floor, Yukari stands alone, then walks slowly forward, looking around.
column2: 在这一层的另一处，由加莉独自站着，然后缓缓向前走，环顾四周。

column1: A Shadow with clawed hands creeps up behind Yukari and lunges at her.
column2: 一只长着利爪的暗影悄悄爬到由加莉身后，朝她扑去。

column1: You break into a run through the corridors. You reach Yukari and plant yourself between her and the Shadow.
column2: 你冲进走廊奔跑。你赶到由加莉身边，挡在她和暗影之间。

column1: The Shadow is gone. You and Yukari stand facing each other in the corridor.
column2: 暗影消失了。你和由加莉在走廊里面对面站着。

column1: Mitsuru and Akihiko run up and stop beside you.
column2: 美鹤和明彦跑过来，在你身旁停下。

column1: Back in Tartarus's entrance hall, the six of you stand together.
column2: 回到塔尔塔罗斯的大厅，你们六人站在一起。

column1: The arcade in Paulownia Mall, a row of game cabinets. You sit at one, hands on the controls, playing. Another player sits at a machine nearby.
column2: 桐叶购物中心的游戏厅，一排街机。你坐在其中一台前，双手握着操作杆玩着。附近的另一台机器前坐着另一位玩家。

column1: Chagall Café, a coffee shop in Paulownia Mall, with customers at its tables and a waiter passing between them. You sit alone at a table, your bag beside you, lift your cup and sip, then set it back on its saucer.
column2: 咖啡店夏卡尔，桐叶购物中心里的一家咖啡店，桌边坐着客人，服务生在其间穿梭。你独自坐在桌旁，包放在身边，举起杯子啜饮，再把它放回碟子上。

column1: A karaoke booth. You sit alone on the bench at the table, your bag beside you on the tabletop, a microphone in your hand, singing.
column2: 卡拉OK包厢。你独自坐在桌边的长椅上，包放在桌面上，手里拿着麦克风，唱着歌。

column1: Wakatsu, the set-meal restaurant in the Iwatodai Strip Mall. You sit alone at a table before a steaming set meal: rice, miso soup and side dishes on a tray. Chopsticks in hand, you dig in. Two customers chat at a table behind you.
column2: 严户台站前商店街的定食餐厅若津。你独自坐在桌旁，面前是热气腾腾的定食：托盘上有米饭、味噌汤和小菜。你拿起筷子大快朵颐。身后的桌边有两位顾客在聊天。

column1: Hagakure Ramen in the Iwatodai Strip Mall. You sit at the counter, bent over a steaming bowl, eating your noodles with chopsticks. Two customers talk at a table behind you.
column2: 严户台站前商店街的锅岛拉面叶隐。你坐在柜台前，俯身对着一碗冒着热气的面，用筷子吃着面条。身后桌边有两位顾客在交谈。

column1: Wilduck Burger in the Iwatodai Strip Mall. You sit alone in a cushioned booth, a tray of fries and a drink before you, and take a big bite of a burger held in both hands. Other customers sit in the booths behind you.
column2: 严户台站前商店街的怀老鸭汉堡。你独自坐在软垫卡座里，面前是一托盘薯条和一杯饮料，双手捧着汉堡大咬一口。其他顾客坐在你身后的卡座里。

column1: Wilduck Burger. You sit at a table before a tray piled high with burgers, eating one held in both hands.
column2: 怀老鸭汉堡。你坐在桌旁，面前的托盘上堆满汉堡，你双手捧着一个吃着。

column1: You sit hunched over the tray, wincing.
column2: 你弓着身子伏在托盘上，一脸痛苦。

column1: You sit slumped over the tray of unfinished burgers, head bowed.
column2: 你瘫坐在放着吃剩汉堡的托盘前，低着头。

column1: The cinema at Port Island Station. You sit in a plush seat in the rows of the theater, eyes on the screen.
column2: 辰巳港湾人工岛站的电影院。你坐在放映厅一排排座位里的软座上，目光盯着银幕。

column1: Chagall Café in Paulownia Mall. You work behind the counter in an apron, beside glass-domed cake stands, and serve a customer with a shoulder bag while another waitress works nearby.
column2: 桐叶购物中心的咖啡店夏卡尔。你系着围裙在柜台后工作，身旁是玻璃罩蛋糕架，你为一位挎着肩包的顾客服务，另一位女服务生在附近忙碌。

column1: At the end of the shift, the manager, a man in a suit, comes over and speaks to you.
column2: 下班时，经理，一位西装男子，走过来和你说话。

column1: Chagall Café in Paulownia Mall, crowded with customers. In your apron, you hurry along the counter to serve them while a waitress takes orders beside you.
column2: 桐叶购物中心的咖啡店夏卡尔，挤满了客人。你系着围裙，沿着柜台匆匆为他们服务，一位女服务生在你身旁接单。

column1: Be Blue V, the healing and accessory shop in Paulownia Mall. In a store shirt, you work behind the counter with a coworker, a young woman in a dress, while customers browse the shelves.
column2: Be Blue V，桐叶购物中心的治疗与饰品店。你穿着店里的衬衫在柜台后工作，旁边是同事，一位穿连衣裙的年轻女子，顾客们在货架间挑选。

column1: At the end of the shift, your coworker turns to you and talks with you.
column2: 下班时，你的同事转向你，和你聊起来。

column1: Be Blue V, the healing and accessory shop in Paulownia Mall, packed with customers. In a store shirt, you stand behind the counter beside a coworker in a dress, while the manager, a woman in a long coat, gives you instructions.
column2: Be Blue V，桐叶购物中心的治疗与饰品店，挤满了顾客。你穿着店里的衬衫站在柜台后，身旁是穿连衣裙的同事，而经理，一位穿长外套的女子，向你交代工作。

column1: At the end of the shift, the manager talks with you.
column2: 下班时，经理和你谈话。

column1: The snack bar at the cinema in Port Island Station: popcorn machines and a hot snack case behind the counter. In a staff shirt, you serve a line of customers beside a coworker.
column2: 辰巳港湾人工岛站电影院的小吃柜台：柜台后有爆米花机和热食柜。你穿着员工衬衫，与一位同事一起为排队的顾客服务。

column1: At the end of the shift, a man in an apron walks over to you beside a case of boxed popcorn by the swing doors and talks with you.
column2: 下班时，一位系着围裙的男子走到你身旁，旁边的弹簧门边放着一箱盒装爆米花，他和你谈话。

column1: The snack bar at the cinema in Port Island Station, with a long line of customers at the counter. In a staff shirt, you hurry to serve them.
column2: 辰巳港湾人工岛站电影院的小吃柜台，柜台前排着长队。你穿着员工衬衫，匆匆为他们服务。

column1: At the end of the shift, a coworker in an apron walks over to you and talks with you.
column2: 下班时，一位系着围裙的同事走到你身旁，和你谈话。

column1: Outside Be Blue V, the healing shop in Paulownia Mall. You stand alone beneath its sign, hands in your pockets, bag on your shoulder.
column2: 桐叶购物中心的治疗店Be Blue V外。你独自站在招牌下，双手插在口袋里，包背在肩上。

column1: Inside Be Blue V, the healing shop in Paulownia Mall, by its display counters beneath the shop's sign. Yukari stands facing you.
column2: 桐叶购物中心的治疗店Be Blue V里面，在陈列柜旁，店招牌下方。由加莉面对着你站着。

column1: Yukari turns and walks off past the counters, deeper into the shop.
column2: 由加莉转身，从柜台旁走过，走向店铺深处。

column1: Later, Yukari walks back to you.
column2: 稍后，由加莉走回你身边。

column1: Paulownia Mall, inside the shop Be Blue V, beside its big sign. You stand with your hands in your pockets; Junpei stands facing you, a hand on his hip.
column2: 桐叶购物中心，Be Blue V店内，大招牌旁。你双手插在口袋里站着；顺平面对着你站着，一只手叉着腰。

column1: Junpei turns and walks off for the treatment, leaving you waiting by the sign.
column2: 顺平转身去接受治疗，留下你在招牌旁等候。

column1: Later, Junpei walks back to you.
column2: 稍后，顺平走回你身边。

column2: 桐叶购物中心，Be Blue V店内，柜台旁。你双手插在口袋里站着；明彦面对着你站着。

column1: Akihiko turns and walks off for the treatment, leaving you waiting by the sign.
column2: 明彦转身去接受治疗，留下你在招牌旁等候。

column2: 桐叶购物中心Be Blue V店内，墙上的大招牌旁。你背着包，一只手插在口袋里，面对美鹤站着，她一只手搭在腰上。

column1: Mitsuru turns and walks off for the treatment, leaving you waiting by the sign.
column2: 美鹤转身去接受治疗，留下你在招牌旁等候。

column1: Later, Mitsuru walks back to you.
column2: 稍后，美鹤走回你身边。

column2: 桐叶购物中心Be Blue V店内，大招牌下的柜台旁。你背着包，双手插在口袋里站着；埃癸斯面对着你站着。

column1: Aigis turns and walks off for the treatment, leaving you waiting by the sign.

column2: 桐叶购物中心，Be Blue V店内，柜台旁。你双手插在口袋里站着；虎狼丸面对着你站着。

column2: 虎狼丸转身小跑着去接受治疗，留下你在招牌旁等候。

column2: 稍后，虎狼丸小跑着回到你身边。

column1: Inside Be Blue V, the healing shop in Paulownia Mall, by its display counters beneath the shop's sign. You stand with your hands in your pockets; Ken stands facing you.
column2: 桐叶购物中心的治疗店Be Blue V里面，在陈列柜旁，店招牌下方。你双手插在口袋里站着；乾面对着你站着。

column1: Ken turns and walks off past the counters, deeper into the shop, leaving you waiting by the sign.
column2: 乾转身，从柜台旁走过，走向店铺深处，留下你在招牌旁等候。

column2: 稍后，乾走回你身边。

column1: Paulownia Mall, inside the shop Be Blue V, beside its big sign. You stand with your bag over your shoulder; Shinjiro faces you, hands in his coat pockets, and soon rubs the back of his head.
column2: 桐叶购物中心，Be Blue V店内，大招牌旁。你背着包站着；真次郎面对着你，双手插在外套口袋里，不一会儿揉了揉后脑勺。

column1: Shinjiro turns and walks off for the treatment, leaving you waiting by the sign.
column2: 真次郎转身去接受治疗，留下你在招牌旁等候。

column1: Later, Shinjiro walks back to you.
column2: 稍后，真次郎走回你身边。

column1: Your room in the dorm. You sit at your desk with a book open, working through problems.
column2: 你在宿舍的房间里。你坐在桌前，翻开一本书，埋头做着题。

column1: The school library. You sit at a long table with a book open, studying, while other students read at the tables around you.
column2: 学校图书馆。你坐在长桌旁，翻开书本学习，周围桌边还有其他学生在读书。

column1: You walk into Club Escapade through padded double doors. Past the entrance, a crowd dances on a floor with the club's name across it, beside a long bar and a stage.
column2: 你穿过软垫双开门，走进放纵俱乐部。进门之后，一群人在地板上跳舞，地上写着俱乐部的名字，旁边是一条长长的吧台和一座舞台。

column1: Elizabeth stands outside the Velvet Room door in Paulownia Mall, waiting. You walk up to her.
column2: 伊莉莎白站在桐叶购物中心的天鹅绒房间门外等候。你走向她。

column1: The arcade in Paulownia Mall. You stand at a claw machine stacked with boxed prizes and work its controls.
column2: 桐叶购物中心的游戏厅。你站在一台堆满盒装奖品的抓娃娃机前，操作着控制杆。

column1: You step back, hands in your pockets, and watch the claw. It closes on a box and lifts it, and you look pleased.
column2: 你双手插在口袋里退后一步，看着爪子。它抓住一个盒子，把它提了起来，你露出满意的神情。

column1: The arcade in Paulownia Mall. You stand at a claw machine stacked with boxed figures and work its controls.
column2: 桐叶购物中心的游戏厅。你站在一台堆满盒装手办的抓娃娃机前，操作着控制杆。

column1: You step back with your hands in your pockets and watch the claw drop. It rises empty, and your shoulders slump.
column2: 你双手插在口袋里退后一步，看着爪子落下。它空着升了回去，你的肩膀垮了下来。

column1: Ahead of you, the girl from the pier runs off up a path into the woods. You stop and watch her go.
column2: 在你前方，码头上的那个女孩沿着小路跑进树林。你停下脚步，看着她离去。

column1: As you come near, the girl from the pier runs on, farther up the path through the woods.
column2: 你走近时，码头上的那个女孩继续跑去，沿着穿过树林的小路跑得更远。

column1: Far up the path, the girl from the pier runs on through the woods, and you stop to watch her.
column2: 在小路的远处，码头上的那个女孩继续穿过树林奔跑，你停下来看着她。

column1: The girl from the pier runs on ahead of you again, deeper into the woods.
column2: 码头上的那个女孩又一次跑到你前面，跑进树林深处。

column1: On the dorm rooftop, Ikutsuki stands waiting for you with his arms folded, beside a row of planters full of soil set out along the wall, a watering can and a tray of small pots beside them.
column2: 宿舍天台上，几月双臂交叉站着等你，墙边摆着一排盛满泥土的花盆，旁边还有一把喷壶和一盘小花盆。

column1: You come in through the dorm's front door with your bag over your shoulder. Mitsuru walks across the lounge to meet you and stops, a hand on her hip.
column2: 你背着包从宿舍前门走进来。美鹤穿过休息室来迎接你，停下脚步，一只手搭在腰上。

column1: The dorm lounge. You come in through the front door, and Mitsuru walks over to meet you.
column2: 宿舍休息室。你从前门走进来，美鹤走过来迎接你。

column1: Junpei walks over to join you and Mitsuru.
column2: 顺平走过来，加入你和美鹤。

column1: You come in through the dorm's front door with your bag over your shoulder. Mitsuru walks across the lounge to meet you and stands with a hand on her hip.
column2: 你背着包从宿舍前门走进来。美鹤穿过休息室来迎接你，站着，一只手搭在腰上。

column1: The dorm lounge. Fuuka walks over to meet you.
column2: 宿舍休息室。风花走过来迎接你。

column1: The dorm's upstairs hallway, a long carpet runner between the room doors and the staircase. You walk along it, hands in your pockets.
column2: 宿舍的楼上走廊，长长的地毯铺在各个房门和楼梯之间。你双手插在口袋里沿着走廊走。

column1: The dorm lounge. You walk up to the front desk, where a cardboard box sits beside a stack of papers.
column2: 宿舍休息室。你走到前台，那里有一个纸箱，放在一叠文件旁。

column1: The dorm's upstairs hallway. You stand at the door of your room. A cardboard box sits on the floor beside it.
column2: 宿舍的楼上走廊。你站在自己房间的门前。地上有一个纸箱，放在门边。

column1: You walk over to your bed. A small shard lies on the pillow.
column2: 你走到床边。枕头上放着一块小碎片。

column1: You pick up the shard.
column2: 你拾起碎片。

column1: The dorm lounge, by the front doors. You stand with Yukari and Junpei; Junpei's face is grim, and by the end he hangs his head, shoulders slumped.
column2: 宿舍休息室，前门旁。你和由加莉、顺平站在一起；顺平神色凝重，到最后他垂下头，肩膀塌了下来。

column1: You come in through the dorm's front door. A young boy walks over to meet you.
column2: 你从宿舍前门走进来。一个小男孩走过来迎接你。

column1: You come in through the dorm's front door. Mitsuru walks across the lounge to meet you.
column2: 你从宿舍前门走进来。美鹤穿过休息室来迎接你。

column1: The dorm lounge. You stand at the front desk, where a cardboard box sits beside a stack of papers.
column2: 宿舍休息室。你站在前台旁，那里有一个纸箱，放在一叠文件旁。

column1: You come in through the dorm's front door. Junpei hurries over to you; the chairman, Ikutsuki, is in the lounge.
column2: 你从宿舍前门走进来。顺平匆匆迎上来；理事长几月就在休息室里。

column1: Ikutsuki walks up to the two of you and folds his arms, and Junpei turns to him.
column2: 几月走到你们两人面前，双臂交叉，顺平转向他。

column1: Ikutsuki gives you something.
column2: 几月递给你一样东西。

column1: The dorm lounge. Yukari stands facing you.
column2: 宿舍休息室。由加莉面对着你站着。

column1: Yukari turns and walks away across the lounge.
column2: 由加莉转身，穿过休息室走开。

column1: The school's main lobby. You walk across it, hands in your pockets, toward the bulletin board, and stop.
column2: 学校的正厅。你双手插在口袋里穿过大厅，走向布告栏，然后停下。

column1: You and Junpei, his bag over his shoulder, walk into the plaza of Paulownia Mall and stop near the fountain in its middle. Across the plaza, at the foot of a staircase, stands a small police box with a bicycle parked by its door.
column2: 你和顺平走进桐叶购物中心的广场，他的包背在肩上，你们在广场中央的喷泉附近停下。广场对面，在一段楼梯脚下，有一座小小的派出所，门边停着一辆自行车。

column1: Paulownia Mall's Fountain Square: a round plaza with a fountain at its centre, ringed by shopfronts and an arcade, people strolling past and sitting at the fountain's edge. You walk in a few steps and stop.
column2: 桐叶购物中心的喷泉广场：一座圆形广场，中央有一座喷泉，周围环绕着店铺和游戏厅，行人从旁走过，也有人坐在喷泉边上。你走进去几步，停下。

column1: In Tartarus, you run in with your teammates close behind and skid to a halt, weapons drawn, as a battle begins.
column2: 塔尔塔罗斯里，你带着队友们紧跟着冲进来，刹住脚步，亮出武器，战斗开始了。

column1: In Tartarus, a Shadow shaped like a giant hand scurries away down a long corridor on its fingertips and disappears around a corner.
column2: 塔尔塔罗斯里，一只形如巨手的暗影用指尖飞快地沿着长长的走廊逃去，拐过一个转角消失了。

column1: You and your teammates run after it, weapons in hand.
column2: 你和队友们提着武器追了上去。

column1: In Tartarus, a Shadow shaped like a giant hand scurries away across the floor on its fingertips and disappears from sight.
column2: 塔尔塔罗斯里，一只形如巨手的暗影用指尖飞快地跑过地面，消失不见。

column1: In Tartarus, a giant hand with a mask for a face creeps along on its fingertips.
column2: 塔尔塔罗斯里，一只脸上戴着面具的巨手用指尖爬行。

column1: You and your teammates stand ready, weapons out. The masked hand rears up nearby, turns this way and that, then swoops off.
column2: 你和队友们严阵以待，武器出鞘。戴面具的手在附近立起，左右转动，随后掠走了。

column1: In a Tartarus room, a masked Shadow shaped like a hand scuttles across the floor on its fingertips, stands upright, flips upside down in the air, lands, and vanishes in a burst of smoke.
column2: 塔尔塔罗斯的一个房间里，一只戴着面具、形如手的暗影用指尖在地上爬行，直立起来，在空中倒翻，落地，然后在一团烟雾中消失。

column1: In Tartarus, a treasure chest sits on a draped pedestal. A giant hand reaches in from the side, the chest springs open, and the hand pulls away, leaving the lid open.
column2: 塔尔塔罗斯里，一只宝箱放在铺着帷布的台座上。一只巨手从旁边伸进来，宝箱弹开，手缩了回去，留下敞开的箱盖。

column1: In Tartarus, a Shadow shaped like a giant hand, a mask at its wrist, scuttles in on its fingertips and wanders about, turning this way and that.
column2: 塔尔塔罗斯里，一只形如巨手、手腕处有面具的暗影用指尖爬进来，四处游荡，左右转动。

column1: You and your teammates charge at it. The hand spins around and spots you.
column2: 你和队友们向它冲去。那只手转过身，发现了你们。

column1: In a Tartarus corridor, a tall figure in a tattered cloak, wreathed in flame, a long-barrelled gun in each hand, comes walking toward you.
column2: 塔尔塔罗斯的走廊里，一个披着破烂斗篷、身缠火焰的高大身影，双手各持一把长管枪，朝你走来。

column1: In Tartarus, you crouch down beside the missing person you have found.
column2: 塔尔塔罗斯里，你蹲在你找到的失踪者身旁。

column1: Tartarus. You crouch on the floor beside the lost cat you found on this floor.
column2: 塔尔塔罗斯。你蹲在地上，在这一层找到的走失的猫旁边。

column1: On a small table beside a lantern sits a large chest shaped like a briefcase, a column of sparks rising from its lid.
column2: 一张小桌上，灯笼旁放着一只形如公文包的大箱子，一串火花从箱盖上升起。

column1: Beside a round seal set into the floor, a Shadow drags itself along on long clawed hands.
column2: 在嵌入地面的圆形封印旁，一只暗影用长着利爪的长臂拖着身子爬行。

column1: You run ahead with your weapon out, your party close behind, and stop face to face with what waits there.
column2: 你亮出武器向前冲去，队伍紧跟在后，面对着等在那里的东西停下。

column1: You step up and hold out a hand, your party standing by with weapons ready.
column2: 你走上前，伸出一只手，队伍在一旁武器待命。

column1: You hold out a hand while your party stands by with weapons ready.
column2: 你伸出一只手，队伍在一旁武器待命。

column1: A small orb takes shape at your outstretched hand.
column2: 一颗小小的光球在你伸出的手上成形。

column1: You and your party walk up to a sealed door at the top of a flight of steps.
column2: 你和队伍走到一段台阶顶端的一扇封印之门前。

column1: A ring of energy swirls across the doorway.
column2: 一圈能量在门口旋转。

column1: The ring shrinks away to nothing, and shards burst out and scatter across the floor around you.
column2: 光环缩小至消失，碎片迸射出来，散落在你周围的地面上。

column1: You lay a hand on a tall grandfather clock.
column2: 你把手放在一座高大的落地钟上。

column1: Its pendulum swings, and sparkles swirl up around you.
column2: 钟摆摆动，闪光在你周围旋转升起。

column1: You run forward with your party, weapons drawn, and all of you pull up together.
column2: 你和队伍提着武器向前跑去，一同停下脚步。

column1: Ahead stands a Shadow shaped like a hand with a mask, balanced on its fingertips. It turns around.
column2: 前方站着一只形如手的暗影，戴着面具，用指尖保持平衡。它转过身来。

column1: It starts, as if it has noticed something, then scurries away out of sight.
column2: 它猛地一惊，像是察觉到了什么，随即飞快地逃得不见踪影。

column1: At the end of a hall, up a short flight of steps, stands an arched door sealed by a jagged lattice. You and your party walk up to it.
column2: 在大厅尽头，几级台阶之上，有一扇拱门，被锯齿状的格栅封住。你和队伍走向它。

column1: The seal on the door swirls into a ring, shrinks away to nothing, and shards burst out across the whole floor.
column2: 门上的封印旋成一个环，缩小至消失，碎片迸射到整个楼层各处。

column1: You stand in a hall of tall pillars, your teammates behind you with weapons ready. A tall clock with a swinging pendulum rises from a round seal in the floor, and a small object lies near it. You walk up to the clock and look up at it.
column2: 你站在一座有高大立柱的大厅里，队友们在你身后武器待命。一座摆着钟摆的高大时钟从地板上的圆形封印中升起，旁边有一件小东西。你走到时钟前，抬头看着它。

column1: You turn aside and read through a small booklet in your hand.
column2: 你转到一旁，翻阅手里的一本小册子。

column1: You lay a hand on the clock. Its hands turn and it chimes.
column2: 你把手放在时钟上。指针转动，钟声响起。

column1: Hands in your pockets, you stroll up to a tall grandfather clock standing in a ring set into the floor.
column2: 你双手插在口袋里，漫步走向立在地板圆环中的一座高大落地钟。

column1: You raise a hand to the clock, and its hands begin to turn.
column2: 你向时钟抬起一只手，它的指针开始转动。

column1: The Great Clock's face opens, and gears turn inside it.
column2: 大时钟的钟面打开，里面的齿轮转动起来。

column1: You run across the floor, sword in hand. Ahead crouches a Shadow, a mass of clawed arms around a mask.
column2: 你手握长剑跑过地面。前方蹲伏着一只暗影，一团长着利爪的手臂围着一张面具。

column1: It charges wildly past you, then stops and casts about, searching.
column2: 它从你身旁疯狂冲过，然后停下，四处张望寻找。

column1: Across the floor, a Shadow, a mass of clawed arms, wanders in an aimless zigzag, lurching this way and that.
column2: 地面另一头，一只暗影，一团长着利爪的手臂，漫无目的地曲折游荡，东倒西歪。

column1: You come into a hall, sword in hand. Ahead, a Shadow, a mass of clawed arms around a mask, prowls toward you.
column2: 你手握长剑走进大厅。前方，一只暗影，一团长着利爪的手臂围着一张面具，朝你逼近。

column1: It searches about and spots you, then turns and flees, and stops to cower in place.
column2: 它四处搜寻，发现了你，然后转身逃走，停下来缩成一团。

column1: Standing before the sealed chest, you hold out a small fragment in your open hand.
column2: 你站在封闭的宝箱前，摊开手掌，托着一块小碎片。

column1: Mitsuru leads you, Yukari and Akihiko along a high wall, and the four of you come to a stop together.
column2: 美鹤带着你、由加莉和明彦沿着一堵高墙前进，你们四人一同停下。

column1: In the dorm, you and Yukari run onto a stair landing. A heavy crash shakes the building, and you both stop short and brace.
column2: 宿舍里，你和由加莉跑上楼梯平台。一声巨响震动了整座建筑，你们两人猛地停下，紧绷身体。

column1: Out on the monorail's elevated track, high above the city, you run along the rails with Junpei and Yukari, then stop.
column2: 在高架轻轨的轨道上，高高悬在城市之上，你与顺平、由加莉沿着铁轨奔跑，然后停下。

column1: In a hallway of the love hotel, Akihiko and Mitsuru come running up to you and Yukari.
column2: 在情人旅馆的走廊里，明彦和美鹤向你和由加莉跑来。

column1: Yukari glares, and Mitsuru looks taken aback.
column2: 由加莉瞪着眼，美鹤显得吃了一惊。

column1: In a hallway of the love hotel, Junpei and Akihiko come running up to you and Yukari.

column2: 伊莉莎白怀抱一本大书，等在天鹅绒房间的门口。她侧身站到一旁，示意你进门，你走了进去，她跟在你身后。

column1: A door opens at the end of the Velvet Room hall. Elizabeth steps out first, a large book in her hand, and you follow her out.
column2: 天鹅绒房间大厅尽头的一扇门打开。伊莉莎白先走出来，手里拿着一本大书，你跟着她走出来。

column1: Elizabeth stands beside the Velvet Room door, a large book in her arms. You walk up to her.
column2: 伊莉莎白站在天鹅绒房间的门旁，怀里抱着一本大书。你走向她。

column1: Elizabeth stands beside the Velvet Room door, a large book in her arms. Hands in your pockets, you walk up to her.
column2: 伊莉莎白站在天鹅绒房间的门旁，怀里抱着一本大书。你双手插在口袋里走向她。

column1: Standing in the Tartarus entrance hall, you take something small from your pocket and look down at it.
column2: 你站在塔尔塔罗斯大厅里，从口袋里拿出一件小东西，低头看着它。

column1: On the way into the Velvet Room, a long hall of doorways rushes past, one after another without end.
column2: 走进天鹅绒房间的途中，一条长长的、两侧都是门的大厅从身旁飞掠而过，一扇接着一扇，没有尽头。

column1: In the entrance hall of Tartarus, your friends stand by the stairs talking, while Elizabeth waits apart from them, watching you.
column2: 在塔尔塔罗斯的大厅里，你的朋友们站在楼梯旁交谈，伊莉莎白则站在一旁，注视着你。

column1: You walk over to Elizabeth, who stands beside the Velvet Room door holding a large book in front of her.
column2: 你走向伊莉莎白，她站在天鹅绒房间的门旁，把一本大书抱在身前。

column1: Outside Iwatodai Station, you stand on the plaza with a bag over your shoulder. A few people sit and stand by the station wall behind you.
column2: 严户台站外，你背着包站在广场上。你身后的车站墙边，有几个人或坐或站。

column1: You walk along a street, hands in your pockets. A coffin stands upright on the pavement, and you walk past it without a glance.
column2: 你双手插在口袋里沿着街道走。一口棺材直立在人行道上，你看也不看就从它旁边走过。

column1: You walk up to the Iwatodai Dorm, an old building, and climb its front steps to a pair of double doors.
column2: 你走向严户台分舍，一座老旧的建筑，登上前门台阶，来到一扇双开门前。

column1: You push the doors open and go in. The title appears: Persona 3 Reload.
column2: 你推开门走了进去。标题出现：女神异闻录3 Reload。

column1: Inside, a lobby with sofas and a front desk. You walk up to the desk.
column2: 里面是一间有沙发和前台的大厅。你走向前台。

column1: A boy in striped pyjamas peers over the top of the front desk. He snaps his fingers and is gone, and you turn around.
column2: 一个穿条纹睡衣的男孩从前台上方探出头来。他打了个响指就消失了，你转过身。

column1: The boy stands in the hall in front of you. He breaks apart into specks and appears again at the end of the front desk, by the sofas. A closed book lies on the desk.
column2: 男孩站在你面前的大厅里。他碎成点点微粒，又出现在前台尽头、沙发旁。桌上放着一本合上的书。

column1: The boy has opened the book on the desk; beside it lie a quill pen and a bell. You step up to the desk and pick up the pen.
column2: 男孩已把书翻开放在桌上；旁边有一支羽毛笔和一只铃铛。你走到桌前，拿起笔。

column1: The boy in striped pyjamas takes the signed contract, reads it and hugs it to his chest, then holds it up beside his head.
column2: 穿条纹睡衣的男孩拿起签好的契约，读了读，抱在胸前，然后举到头旁。

column1: The boy stretches one arm out toward you, then breaks apart into flecks and is gone. You stand alone by the front desk.
column2: 男孩朝你伸出一只手臂，随后碎成点点微粒消失了。你独自站在前台旁。

column1: Yukari, a girl about your age, stands at the foot of the stairs, frowning at you, braced as if for a fight. A gun hangs in a holster on her thigh.
column2: 由加莉，一个和你年纪相仿的女孩，站在楼梯脚下，皱着眉看着你，摆出一副随时要动手的架势。她大腿上的枪套里挂着一把枪。

column1: Yukari edges toward you, her hand creeping down to the gun at her thigh.
column2: 由加莉朝你挪近，手悄悄滑向大腿上的枪。

column1: Behind Yukari, Mitsuru, a young woman with long hair, stands in the hallway with one hand on her hip. Yukari draws the gun from her thigh and holds it down at her side.
column2: 美鹤，一位长发的年轻女子，站在由加莉身后的走廊里，一只手搭在腰上。由加莉从大腿上拔出枪，垂在身侧。

column1: Mitsuru walks down the hallway to the front desk, where you stand with Yukari, and stops with a hand on her hip. She too wears a holstered gun.
column2: 美鹤沿走廊走到前台，你和由加莉站在那里，她停下，一只手搭在腰上。她也佩着枪套里的枪。

column1: Yukari leads you up the stairs and along a hallway on the second floor, to the door at its far end.
column2: 由加莉带你上楼，沿着二楼的走廊，走到走廊尽头的门前。

column1: Yukari walks back past you down the hall while you step over to your door; then she stops and turns back to you.
column2: 由加莉从你身边走回走廊，你走到自己的门前；然后她停下，转身回头看你。

column1: In your dorm room, you stand at a small sink, fixing your hair. Someone knocks at the door.
column2: 在你宿舍的房间里，你站在小水槽前整理头发。有人敲门。

column1: You cross to the door and open it. Yukari stands outside, her school bag in one hand.
column2: 你走到门口打开。由加莉站在外面，一只手拎着书包。

column1: At the school's entrance, among rows of shoe lockers, Yukari walks a few steps ahead of you, then turns to face you.
column2: 在学校入口，一排排鞋柜之间，由加莉在你前面几步走着，然后转身面对你。

column1: Yukari turns and walks off, leaving you by the shoe lockers.
column2: 由加莉转身走开，留下你站在鞋柜旁。

column1: In the faculty office, between desks piled with papers, a woman in a suit stands with her back to you. She turns and walks over, a folder in her hand.
column2: 教职员办公室里，在堆满文件的办公桌之间，一位穿西装的女士背对着你站着。她转身走过来，手里拿着一份文件夹。

column1: The school auditorium, during the opening ceremony: a man speaks from a podium on the stage. You sit among the students, facing the stage. In the row behind you, a classmate leans forward to whisper.
column2: 学校礼堂，开学典礼：一个男人在舞台的讲台上讲话。你坐在学生们中间，面朝舞台。你身后一排的同学探身过来低声说话。

column1: Your classroom, as the bell rings at the end of the day. You are at your desk; a boy walks over to you with a grin, and you stand up.
column2: 你的教室，放学的铃声响起。你坐在座位上；一个男生笑着走到你面前，你站了起来。

column1: Yukari walks up to the two of you.
column2: 由加莉走到你们两人面前。

column1: Junpei stares at her, open-mouthed.
column2: 顺平张着嘴盯着她。

column1: Yukari turns on her heel and walks off between the desks and out of the classroom.
column2: 由加莉一个转身，从课桌之间走出教室。

column1: You walk across the school grounds beside Junpei, bags in hand, along a path lined with trees. Off to the side, Akihiko stands talking with two girls. Then a group of students in running gear jogs past you.
column2: 你和顺平并肩走过校园，手里拎着包，沿着两旁种着树的小路。侧边，明彦正和两个女生说话。接着一队穿着运动服的学生从你们身旁跑过。

column1: The dorm lounge. Mitsuru sits on the sofa reading a book. Akihiko, a bandage on his brow, walks up behind her.
column2: 宿舍休息室。美鹤坐在沙发上看书。明彦额头贴着绷带，从她身后走来。

column1: Akihiko walks off toward the front door.
column2: 明彦朝前门走去。

column2: 门在他身后关上。美鹤闭上眼睛，神色失望。

column2: 严户台站前商店街，挤满购物的人和学生。你背着包沿街走。一家汉堡店外，顺平站着和坐在长椅上的同学聊天。你看了他们一会儿，然后转身继续走。

column2: 你带着包走进宿舍休息室。由加莉坐在沙发上，对面是一个戴眼镜、留长发的男人。

column2: 你放下包，坐下面对他们。

column1: Ikutsuki has risen; he turns and walks out of the lounge.
column2: 几月已站起身；他转身走出休息室。

column2: 宿舍里的一个房间，满是显示器和一台大型控制台。美鹤和由加莉坐在控制台前。上方的大屏幕上显示着你，正睡在床上。几月从她们身后走进来。

column1: A back alley by the station. Young people stand around in twos and threes, talking. A man in a suit sits slumped on some steps, head down, a radio beside him.
column2: 车站旁的一条后巷。年轻人三三两两地站着聊天。一个穿西装的男人瘫坐在台阶上，低着头，身旁放着一台收音机。

column1: The same alley, now silent. Where the young people stood, tall coffins stand upright. The man still sits alone on the steps.
column2: 同一条后巷，此刻一片死寂。年轻人刚才站的地方，立着高大的棺材。那个男人仍独自坐在台阶上。

column1: He gets up and walks out among the coffins, looking around.
column2: 他站起来，走进棺材之间，环顾四周。

column1: Drops of something thick fall and spread into a pool on the ground around his shoes.
column2: 一些黏稠的东西滴落下来，在他鞋子周围的地上积成一滩。

column1: He drops to his knees, clutching his head.
column2: 他双膝跪地，抱住了头。

column1: The room with the monitors. Mitsuru and Yukari sit at the console, Ikutsuki standing beside them. The big screen shows you, asleep in your bed under a checked blanket.
column2: 有显示器的房间。美鹤和由加莉坐在控制台前，几月站在她们身旁。大屏幕上显示着你，盖着格子毯子睡在床上。

column2: 一间有着高大华丽的墙壁的房间，墙上嵌着一个转动着指针的大钟面。一位长鼻子的老人坐在圆桌旁的高背扶手椅里，双手交叠托着下巴；一位年轻女子站在他身旁，捧着一本大书。你坐在桌子对面的椅子上。

column2: 桌子上方浮现出一个小球，随后消散，留下一张纸躺在桌上。

column1: A small light drifts down from above and circles beside you.
column2: 一点小小的光从上方飘落，在你身旁盘旋。

column1: In the classroom, you sit at your desk as Junpei walks up to you.
column2: 教室里，你坐在座位上，顺平走到你面前。

column1: A paved plaza around a fountain, ringed by shopfronts and an arcade, with people passing through. You and Junpei walk in, school bags in hand.
column2: 一片铺着石板的广场围绕着一座喷泉，四周是店铺和游戏厅，人来人往。你和顺平走进来，手里拎着书包。

column1: Junpei spots a crane game outside the arcade and hurries over to it, grinning.
column2: 顺平发现游戏厅外有一台抓娃娃机，咧嘴笑着匆匆跑了过去。

column1: In your dorm room, still in your school uniform, you sit down on the edge of the bed, shoulders slumped, head bowed.
column2: 在你宿舍的房间里，你仍穿着校服，坐到床沿上，肩膀垮着，低着头。

column2: 你向后倒在床上，一只手臂搭在额头上，然后放下来，盯着天花板。

column2: 你朝天花板举起一只手。几点细小的光芒在你指间闪烁，随后消散。
